description:
Hushfeed v0.43.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

One new patch, from a feature request. Use system font draws TikTok's text in your device's own font instead of TikTok Sans, at the same weight, while the icons, the gift animations and the @ and # glyphs keep their own fonts. It is off by default and needs a restart.

Validation: 1423 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
